proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal – Production of a Report on the "Statement on the Purpose of a Corporation"
proposals.proponent: Trio Foundation (represented by As You Sow)
proposals.topic_summary: Requests the Board prepare a report reviewing the BRT Statement on the Purpose of a Corporation and provide its perspective on how governance and management systems should be altered to implement it.
proposals.evidence: The Board unanimously recommends that you vote "AGAINST" this proposal.
